scenes.heading: AN AI TUTOR WITH A VISIBLE MEMORY
scenes.say: An AI tutor with a memory you can actually see and edit.

scenes.heading: DeepTutor
scenes.sub: a tutor that keeps learning about you
scenes.say: It's called DeepTutor. It tracks what you learn over time, so the next lesson starts where you actually are.

scenes.heading: THREE MEMORY LAYERS
scenes.say: Session traces feed surface summaries, and those feed a synthesis. Each memory links back to the evidence it came from.

scenes.heading: EVERY MEMORY, TRACEABLE
scenes.say: Open the memory graph and see which study session each fact came from. You can edit it.

scenes.heading: WHAT IT TAKES
scenes.say: It is a full self-hosted app. Install it with pip or Docker, then add your model provider in Settings.
What would you learn with a tutor that remembers you? Comment TUTOR and I'll pin the link.
